title: Trapping Rain Water
inputFormat: Implement trap(height). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return the total number of unit squares of water trapped above the bars.

visuals.title: The lower wall limits the water
visuals.caption: For heights [3,0,2], the middle position holds 2 units of water. The left wall’s extra height cannot raise the water above the right wall.
